justification: One user-facing cell: a failed check printed 'No'. Standard, not critical: one tile, existing helper reused.

pre_impl.existing_data: constraints.notChecked set by app/api/property/route.ts when spatial_overlays fails
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: No list (old saved report) = not checked, per wasNotChecked
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Render-time only, applies to every page view and old saved reports alike

functions.name: wasNotChecked
functions.input: the constraints object from the property lookup payload
functions.output: boolean true when the named check did not answer
functions.if_none: returns true, so the tile reads Not checked

break_it.scenario: The spatial_overlays PostGIS query fails or times out
Old saved report has no notChecked list
break_it.what_happens: Flood tile reads Not checked instead of No
break_it.how: Intended house rule in lib/fact-answer.ts:33 - no list cannot show the check answered

break_it.scenario: Lot is in a flood area and the query also flagged another failure
break_it.what_happens: Shows the flood classification, Yes wins
break_it.how: inFloodArea is checked before the not-checked guard
